interruptions: Tracked result write returned WSL Errno22 after a completed case; frozen commands resume only unfinished workloads and the tracked file is copied at completion.
interpretation: Three shuffled paired samples. Small independent vector oracle validates every answer and final-state word. Large tests compare full input/output/final-state SHA256 across all six processes. Operation timing excludes construction, warmup, hashing, final extraction and destruction; buildcpu and memory recorded separately. Short rows and >15% descriptive regressions are flagged. No AtCoder measurement.
